evidence: Row text (public): 'solve.sh installs to the expected paths and the reference runs under the stated contract. (Network is public - fetching or installing at start is not a defect.)'. Internal sheet says 'with no network / no run-time install'; SKILL delivery profile says network is public, so I applied the public reading, but the golden also satisfies the stricter internal reading (no install, no fetch). solve.sh (task/solution/solve.sh, sha256 1df2ed04...): line 1 '#!/bin/bash', 0 CR bytes, `bash -n` OK; line 3 mkdir -p /app; line 35 `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` (same install as template solve.sh line 5); line 36 removes any stale $DB_PATH(-wal/-shm); lines 5-9 refuse a DB_PATH outside /app; lines 12-34 a node /proc scan that exits 0 immediately on a fresh install (line 16). No writes to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill; no NODE_ENV; no npm/curl/wget/pip. node exists in the agent image (environment/Dockerfile:1 node:22-bookworm-slim). cp -a of app/. leaves the Dockerfile-created /app/.git intact. Entry and contract (instruction.md:13-15, integration.md:3-10): solution/app/server.js requires src/index.js -> bootstrap.start; bootstrap.js:43 listens on Number(process.env.PORT||3000) on 0.0.0.0; bootstrap.js:20-23 answers GET/HEAD /api/health in the main thread before/without the DB worker; worker thread (same process) inherits process.env incl. DB_PATH (bootstrap.js:45) and the inner Express binds 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port (index.js:447). db.js:9 DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || <app>/app.db (i.e. /app/app.db when installed), db.js:62 seedIfEmpty returns when users exist -> idempotent, no reseed on restart. Self-contained: db.js:10 reads seed from src/seed_data.json beside the module (not /assets, not cwd); sha256 a1c65c80... identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json. No reads of /assets or /instructions in src. Dependencies are only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 via NODE_PATH, preinstalled in both environment/Dockerfile:9-12 and tests/Dockerfile:16-22; package.json pins the same versions; no node_modules or app.db shipped (solution/app holds package.json, server.js, public/, src/). No http(s) URLs in solution/app/public. Launch in test.sh:104-111 (env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT=3000 DB_PATH, setpriv uid 65534, node /app/server.js or /tmp/submission/server.js copy) is satisfied by these properties, including the copy fallback because seed/DB paths are __dirname-relative or DB_PATH-driven. Run evidence: raw-evidence-index.json entries re-hashed (all 6 artifact sha256 match) and its matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen solution bytes I hashed. workspace.json: 25/25 results passed, page_errors []; driver workspace.cjs:16 launches `node /app/server.js` with cwd /tmp, env PORT=3000, DB_PATH=/tmp/hireops-workspace.db, NODE_PATH; restart case (lines ~511-522) asserts applications/activity/unread unchanged after SIGTERM+relaunch -> 'restart keeps ... without reseeding' passed. server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice. Adversarial: (a) a broken golden that read /assets/seed_data.json at runtime would pass a scripted run in an image that has /assets; this golden does not (seed read from src/). (b) A golden whose default DB is cwd-relative would break when test.sh runs from another cwd; this one is __dirname-relative and test.sh always passes DB_PATH anyway. (c) solve.sh refusing DB_PATH outside /app or refusing while the DB is open only affects re-installation; agent image sets no DB_PATH, so the Oracle install path is unaffected. No defect found. Risk=true because required runtime evidence is missing: no recorded execution of solve.sh itself (the evidence driver does not show how /app was populated) and no full configured verifier launch via test.sh in the separate verifier environment with /app artifact transfer (index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'). Scripted golden runs are not Oracle or judge results.
